concepts.title: Linear Expressions and Their Values
concepts.definition: A linear polynomial in one variable has the form m x + c, where the power of x is at most one; putting any value of x gives the value of the expression, so the expression acts like a machine turning inputs into outputs.
concepts.key_idea: One variable, power one: every input x produces one output value.

evaluate the given linear polynomial at the given value
what is the degree of the given linear polynomial
check whether the given expression is a linear polynomial
find x when the value of the expression is given

solution_steps.explain: Scale the input x by m.

concepts.title: Exploring Linear Patterns
concepts.definition: In a linear pattern successive values grow by one fixed step, so each term equals the previous term plus a constant difference; tables of such patterns show equal gaps, which is the signature of linearity.
concepts.key_idea: Equal steps everywhere: constant difference means the pattern is linear.
question_patterns: continue the given linear pattern for three more terms

solution_steps.explain: Every next term comes by adding the fixed difference.

concepts.title: Rate of Change in Linear Relations
concepts.definition: A linear relation changes at a constant rate: the change in output divided by the change in input stays the same for any two pairs of values, and this rate decides how steeply the values climb.
concepts.key_idea: One rate everywhere: equal input steps give equal output steps.
concepts.textbook_ref: iemh102.txt sections on linear patterns and their rate of change
question_patterns: find the rate of change from the given two pairs of values

find the output when the input increases by the given amount
interpret the rate of change in the given situation

solution_steps.explain: Output gap over input gap gives the constant rate.
